summary: Frontend-only validation of the 4-change 'ship' batch on EZtoFind.ca: Doogie embedded chat on /visual-agent-demo, promoted -next routes (communities/about/luxury/equestrian), nav canonicalization, and insights→listings deep-links (buyer + seller). 8/8 scenarios PASS.

doogie_chat_on_visual_agent_demo.notes: Consent gate present (data-testid=doogie-consent-accept) — accepted programmatically. After sending 'What are strata fees?' the assistant streamed a full reply (~1.2KB) via POST /api/doogie/chat. Reply snippet: '## Strata Fees in BC — Strata fees (sometimes called maintenance fees) are monthly payments made by each owner in a strata corporation — think condos, townhouses, or any multi-unit development governed under BC's Strata Property Act. What do they cover? - Common expenses ... Contingency Reserve Fund (CRF) ... Building insurance ...'

route_communities.notes: /communities renders with hn-nav (new CommunitiesNext design). No crash.

buyer_insights_deeplink.notes: Typed 'Kelowna' in buyerinsights-area-input, submitted; buyerinsights-view-listings appeared with text 'View live listings in Kelowna →' and href=/listings?city=Kelowna. Navigation confirmed to /listings?city=Kelowna.

seller_insights_deeplink.notes: Typed 'Surrey' in sellerlookup-area-input, submitted; sellerlookup-view-listings href=/listings?city=Surrey. Navigation confirmed.

console_warnings: PaneBuyerInsights: live insights fetch failed, keeping illustrative stats (TypeError: Failed to fetch). Non-blocking — fallback stats display correctly. Consider verifying the live insights endpoint availability from client-side origin.
critical_code_review_comments: PaneBuyerInsights swallows a client-side fetch failure quietly (warning only). Confirm the target endpoint is same-origin/CORS-clean and, if intentional, downgrade the warning to debug to reduce noise.
App.js is very large (11k+ lines) and exports DoogieChat plus many other components. Consider splitting DoogieChat into its own module to improve maintainability and lazy-load footprint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Doogie embedded chat requires clicking data-testid=doogie-consent-accept once before data-testid=doogie-input becomes visible (embedded mode still gates on consent). Reply arrives via SSE from POST /api/doogie/chat within ~5-10s. Buyer/Seller insights tabs are reached via button:has-text('Buyer Insights'/'Seller Insights'); pause autoplay via data-testid=visual-agent-toggle-play first.
